security_audit.summary: Most static findings are false positives caused by Markdown code fences, inline backticks, SurrealQL examples, and documentation links. No prompt injection or data exfiltration intent was found. One low severity content issue remains because examples reuse root credentials without production guidance.

remediation.issue: Examples use root credentials without production warnings.
remediation.suggestion: Replace sample credentials with placeholders and state that production deployments must use unique users, strong secrets, and secret storage.

content.value_statement: SurrealDB projects need reliable Python examples for queries, graphs, vectors, and live updates. This skill guides SDK usage with focused patterns for data apps and RAG systems.
actual_capabilities: Explains Python SDK connection setup and namespace selection.
Shows CRUD workflows with create, select, update, merge, patch, upsert, and delete operations.
Documents SurrealDB graph relationships, traversal syntax, edge tables, and schema constraints.
Guides vector embedding storage, KNN search, hybrid search, and similarity scoring.
Covers live query subscriptions for real-time data updates.
Provides RAG and LangChain reference patterns using SurrealDB as a vector store.
limitations: It is documentation only and does not run database commands by itself.
Examples target SurrealDB 2.3.x and may need changes for other versions.
It does not verify a live database schema or benchmark query performance.
Embedding examples depend on external model libraries and provider credentials.

use_cases.title: Prototype Multi-Model Data Apps
use_cases.description: Use Python examples to combine documents, graph edges, vectors, and live updates in one SurrealDB project.

use_cases.title: Design Graph Queries
use_cases.description: Model relationships with edge tables, recursive traversal, and constraints before implementing SurrealQL in Python.

use_cases.title: Build Retrieval Workflows
use_cases.description: Plan embedding storage, vector search, hybrid search, and LangChain integration for RAG applications.

prompt_templates.title: Connect to SurrealDB
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the surrealdb-python skill to show a beginner setup for the Python SDK. Include connection flow, namespace selection, and safe credential placeholders.

prompt_templates.title: Plan CRUD Operations
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the surrealdb-python skill to design CRUD operations for a customer records table. Include create, partial update, lookup, and delete guidance.

prompt_templates.title: Model Graph Relationships
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the surrealdb-python skill to design a graph schema for authors, articles, and citations. Include edge metadata and traversal queries.

prompt_templates.title: Build a RAG Search Pattern
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the surrealdb-python skill to plan a RAG workflow that combines embeddings, metadata filters, graph traversal, and live update considerations.

output_examples.input: Design a knowledge graph for research papers and authors.
output: A schema plan with author, paper, and citation records.
Relationship guidance for authored, cites, and related topic edges.
Traversal ideas for finding author networks and citation chains.

output_examples.input: Plan semantic search for support articles.
output_examples.output: The response outlines chunking, embedding generation, vector storage, KNN retrieval, metadata filtering, and result ranking steps.

output_examples.input: Add live updates to a dashboard backed by SurrealDB.
output_examples.output: The response describes live query setup, subscription handling, cleanup, error handling, and data change categories.

best_practices: Use parameterized SurrealQL for user-provided values.
Define schema and indexes before production vector or graph workloads.
Use unique credentials and secret storage for every real deployment.
anti_patterns: Do not copy local root credentials into shared or production systems.
Do not run recursive graph queries without depth limits or timeouts.
Do not mix embedding dimensions across records in the same vector field.

faq.question: Does this skill execute SurrealDB commands?
faq.answer: No. It provides guidance and examples for an AI assistant to adapt in your project.

faq.question: Which SurrealDB version does it target?
faq.answer: The guidance targets SurrealDB 2.3.x and the Python SDK patterns shown in the skill.

faq.question: Can it help with graph databases?
faq.answer: Yes. It covers RELATE statements, edge tables, traversal syntax, recursive queries, and graph schema design.

faq.question: Can it help with vector search?
faq.answer: Yes. It covers embedding storage, KNN search, similarity scoring, hybrid search, and RAG patterns.

faq.question: Does it include LangChain guidance?
faq.answer: Yes. The vector search reference includes a SurrealDBStore pattern for LangChain workflows.

faq.question: Is it safe to use the sample credentials?
faq.answer: Use sample credentials only for local experiments. Production systems need unique users, strong secrets, and managed secret storage.
